title: Encube Ethicals IPO
summary: Encube Ethicals IPO is a ₹3,000 crore book-built issue, proposed to be listed on BSE and NSE. The IPO dates, price band and lot size are yet to be announced.

b.p: Encube Ethicals IPO has a total issue size of ₹3000 Crores and will be listed on BSE, NSE. Price band & Lot size details are yet to be announced.

kv: JM Financial Ltd., Axis Capital Ltd., Kotak Mahindra Capital Co.Ltd.

Encube Ethicals financials show revenue growth and profitability trends over recent years, indicating business stability.

Formed in September 1995, Encube Ethicals Limited is a multinational company that deals with pharmaceutical formulations, particularly topical and transdermal dosage forms, and serves 50 countries, including regulated markets like the United States, the UK, Europe, and India. Encube consists of three interdependent verticals of the business: Global Generics, Global CDMO (Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization), and India Branded Formulations, and it offers end-to-end services from research & development to commercialization. The company is one of the fastest-growing companies in the US topical generics market. · · Encube runs large-scale manufacturing facilities approved by regulators with a high-level R&D infrastructure, innovative product pipeline, and strategic partnerships with the major international pharmaceutical companies. Also, it promotes branded topical products in India through its well-established distribution network. · · Encube puts its efforts into innovation, quality assurance, regulatory compliance, and customer-oriented product development. · · As of March 31, 2026, the number of permanent employees was 1,695, of which 982 were factory workers.
Mehul Madhusudan Shah are the company's promoters of Encube Ethicals.
